payload.entry:
POLICY: ToolRun store keeps 250ms default (zero-means-core-default). Write-open skips SCHEMA_SQL when schema_version, child-observation columns, and required tables (including triage/receipts) are current. One elapsed BusyBudget covers open/WAL/statements/retries; sqlite busy_timeout is sliced to 25ms so sqlite3_open_v2 BUSY is retried. Persist-WAL plus SQLITE_DBCONFIG_NO_CKPT_ON_CLOSE so last-close does not exclusive-checkpoint. Retention FS inspect runs after the writer commit. Busy (extended_code) is distinct from corruption; 0-byte in-progress creates are not quarantined. ToolRun PyO3 defaults pass busy_timeout_ms=0; unrelated telemetry bindings stay 250. No wire schema change.

EVIDENCE: unfixed core 89576266 / sase pin 800caef4. WAL BEGIN IMMEDIATE/EXCLUSIVE never busies a reader; show failure is locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE / last-close checkpoint / sqlite3_open_v2 ignoring busy_timeout. just test -p sase_core tool_run::store: 138 pass, 1 ignored. just test -p sase_core_py timeout: 2 pass. sase tool run 368488858077809ada7e7a75e54808a6: our contention and timeout tests green under the full gate; exit 101 is only federation_worker::imp::tests::ipc::listener_creates_private_socket_and_rejects_symlink (known flake sase-1gz). Do not ratchet the sase pin here — caller-integration owns that.
